[[File:LukeSerpArmor-SW1977-64.jpg|thumb|right|upright|Luke Skywalker wearing Serp armor]]
A kind of '''armor''' was peculiar to the [[Serp]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. The metal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] featured a helmet, [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]], breastplate, vambraces, [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], cuisses, and greaves. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] wore a set of Serp armor while facing the Serp [[King/Legends|King]] [[S'Shah]] in the [[Doom-Joust/Legends|Doom-Jousts]].
